nsight.cuda.languageSupport.provider.description: Selects the CUDA C++ language support provider Nsight should use for this workspace.

nsight.cuda.languageSupport.autoConfigur.description: Automatically checks CUDA workspaces and prompts or applies provider-specific setup when safe.

nsight.cuda.languageSupport.gpuArch.patternErrorMessage: Leave empty to infer the architecture, or enter a CUDA architecture such as sm_90 or compute_90 (optionally with a trailing 'a'). compute_* values are normalized to sm_* for clangd.
nsight.cuda.languageSupport.gpuArch.description: CUDA GPU architecture used when Nsight generates a clangd .clangd file or .clangd.nsight.example, for example sm_90. compute_90 and compute_90a are accepted aliases and written as sm_90 and sm_90a; invalid values fall back to compile_commands.json or the default. Changing this setting does not update an existing project-owned .clangd file.

enumDescriptions: Start cuda-gdbserver on the QNX target (cuda-gdbserver already on target). The debuggee executable is uploaded by CUDA-GDB every debug session.

Start cuda-gdbserver on the QNX target and upload cuda-gdbserver binary to TMPDIR (fallback: /tmp). Every debug session invokes rsync to sync cuda-gdbserver (only transfers if changes detected; falls back to SFTP if rsync unavailable). The debuggee executable is also uploaded by CUDA-GDB every debug session.

sshUsername.description: SSH username for remote autostart (optional; will prompt if missing)

sshKeyPath.description: Path to SSH private key file for authentication (optional; will prompt for auth method if missing)

sshPort.description: SSH port for connecting to QNX target (optional, defaults to 22 if not specified).

localCudaGdbServerPath.description: Path to QNX-compatible cuda-gdbserver binary on your local machine (for 'qnx-remote-upload' mode only). This binary will be copied to the QNX target and executed. Required for qnx-remote-upload mode.

remoteUploadPath.description: Remote directory on QNX target where files should be uploaded and cuda-gdbserver executed (optional). If not specified, queries TMPDIR environment variable with fallback to /tmp. This directory is used for uploading cuda-gdbserver binary (in qnx-remote-upload mode), uploading the debuggee executable, and as the working directory for cuda-gdbserver.

serverEnvironment.description: Environment variables to set in the shell when starting cuda-gdbserver on the QNX target (optional).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=cdt-gdb-adapter && npx node bundle.mts extension debugAdapter
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run build:test
scripts.test:extension-host: npm run build && npm run build:test:extension-host && npx node out/extensionHost/runTest.js
scripts.package: npm run tsc && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run update-notices && npx vsce package
